summary: Iteration 26: Tested new /api/coach/plan-history GET + /api/coach/plan-rollback/{id} POST endpoints, LLM `_variation_instruction` gating helper, and frontend PlanHistory page. All 10 pytest cases pass; regression suite (muscle_groups + email_verification_flag = 21 tests) pass. Frontend loads /plan-history via dashboard [data-testid=plan-history-btn], renders 30 items, exactly 1 AKTIV badge, 29 rollback buttons.

issues: Page is registered WITHOUT ProtectedRoute wrapper in App.js — unauthenticated users can visit the route (they see empty state because api call fails). Consider wrapping in <ProtectedRoute> for consistency.

action_items: Optional: wrap <PlanHistory/> route in <ProtectedRoute> in /app/frontend/src/App.js (line 62) to match other authenticated pages.

Optional: TourGuide overlay blocks [data-testid=plan-history-btn] click on fresh admin sessions — testing worked around it via ÜBERSPRINGEN. Users likely dismiss the tour naturally, but flag if e2e stability matters.
critical_code_review_comments: plan_history.py router is clean (25 LOC), uses uuid IDs, excludes _id, proper ownership check via user_id filter in find_one.
_variation_instruction correctly gates at 4 weeks; uses first_created_at when available (falls back to created_at).
_perform_plan_adjust persists first_created_at on new plans → plan-chain age is tracked correctly across adjust iterations.
Minor: plan_history endpoint has no explicit /api prefix — relies on server.py include_router; verified live URL /api/coach/plan-history works.
PlanHistory.jsx uses window.confirm() (line 24) which is fine functionally but breaks the app's dark-themed UX; consider AlertDialog from shadcn.
seed_data_creation: Rollback-other-user test synthesizes a temporary plan with fake user_id and cleans up in the finally block. Rollback-valid test restores admin current_plan_id in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin has 31 plans in DB. plan_history default limit=30; add ?limit=100 when you need to see the oldest. Rollback route always returns 200 for admin-owned plans; use finally-block teardown to reset current_plan_id. Circular import between server.py and services.llm_coach requires `import server` before `from services.llm_coach import ...` in unit tests.
